clauses.title: Purpose
clauses.meaning: Investigate intrinsic Information Product-family discrimination; prioritize discovery and falsification over confirmation.

clauses.title: Prior research
clauses.meaning: Inherit prospective conditional S04 closure; retain historical C06 approved-not-effective and four 65/6/7/7 ledgers plus separate PC decisions.

clauses.title: Principal question
clauses.meaning: Determine whether Information Product has a defensible intrinsic constitution distinct from other Product families, independent of implementation and consumption.

clauses.title: Competing hypotheses
clauses.meaning: H1 intrinsic family, H2 derived/composite classification, H3 relational/contextual classification, H4 alternative ontology; no presumed truth or exhaustiveness.

clauses.title: Candidate Q0-Q5
clauses.meaning: Q0 independent BPS/PIN Productness; Q1-Q4 universal necessity unestablished; Q0-Q4 joint sufficiency unestablished, not formally disproven; Q5 separate procedural adjudication.

clauses.title: Falsifiability
clauses.meaning: Define subject/Version, claim, counterexample, admissible evidence, oracle, outcome, uncertainty; distinguish conceptual from empirical methods.

clauses.title: Original falsifications
clauses.meaning: Preserve F06/F14/F16 unresolved with original evidence and assumptions; no retrospective execution or closure.

clauses.title: Family boundaries
clauses.meaning: Investigate C02/C21 enriched Data vs Information, C12/C18/C31 multi-Promise and Compound, AI dependency, context, semantics and realization.

clauses.title: Identity invariants
clauses.meaning: Separate Product Kind/instance/Version, Information Proposition, semantic-definition/Version, realization revision, provider/contract Version, plan/binding/compilation, occurrence, evidence, determination, applicability/currentness.

clauses.title: Independent authority
clauses.meaning: Preserve BPS/PIN, GEARM/GEARA, independent Data/AI/Service/Creative/Compound, BPS DPP Core, UPOS/PFI/HDIP, policy/legal and A1-A9 authorities.

clauses.title: Evidence discipline
clauses.meaning: E0 conceptual design distinct from E1 actual reference and E2 actual integrated-PFI execution. G06 E0=62 approved unexecuted; E1=0; E2=0.

clauses.title: Experiment authorization
clauses.meaning: No requirement to execute all 62 designs; separately authorize any E1/E2 scope, oracles, provenance, resources and assessment.

clauses.title: Adversarial classification
clauses.meaning: Distinguish supporting, contradictory, inconclusive, invalid and out-of-scope evidence; no generalization beyond claim.

clauses.title: Negative findings
clauses.meaning: Record alternative explanations, negative results and problem reframing; no mandated conclusion that an intrinsic Information family exists.

clauses.title: Reproducibility
clauses.meaning: Maintain hypothesis/version, subject, provenance, observed or conceptual findings, alternatives, method, evaluator, human disposition, currentness.

clauses.title: Residual obligations
clauses.meaning: Keep G06-RO01-RO12 and G03-R01-R12 all OPEN; mapping is not waiver, transfer, discharge or execution.

clauses.title: Planning work packages
clauses.meaning: B01 charter; B02 ontology; B03 competing-family; B04 falsification; B05 reference evidence; B06 synthesis. No automatic authorization of B02-B06.

clauses.title: Possible research outcomes
clauses.meaning: O1 bounded support of distinct family; O2 alternative classification; O3 revised/rejected candidate; O4 inconclusive; O5 reframing. None automatically normative.

clauses.title: B01 completion
clauses.meaning: Owner must separately accept question, hypotheses, falsifiability, authority, evidence inventory, E0/E1/E2 boundary, adverse findings, non-normative status; B01 not declared complete.

clauses.title: Authorization and non-effect
clauses.meaning: Approve only B01 charter and bounded preparatory work subject to adoption; no B02-B06, E1/E2, repository changes without separate request, normative release, V01 resumption, obligation discharge, S04 reopening.
